name: Oil & Gas Production Accounting
brief: Upstream oil & gas production accounting: daily production capture, Unit-of-Production depletion, royalty and JV accounting.
description: Custom AL extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central supporting daily well production capture, BOE conversion via standard Item Units of Measure, Item Journal integration, Unit-of-Production depletion (Successful Efforts / Full Cost), cash and in-kind royalty settlement, JV cost allocation, dedicated Role Centers and standard production/reserve/reporting. Implements FRD/TRD v2.0 (September 2026).
